features.name: Spellcasting
features.desc: You cast spells from the Bard spell list using Charisma (full caster, prepared spells). A Musical Instrument is your spellcasting focus.

features.name: Bardic Inspiration
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you give a creature a Bardic Inspiration die (d6, increasing to d12). Within 10 minutes, it can add the die to one ability check, attack roll, or saving throw. You can do this a number of times equal to your Charisma modifier.

features.name: Expertise
features.desc: You double your Proficiency Bonus for two chosen skills you're proficient in.

features.name: Jack of All Trades
features.desc: You add half your Proficiency Bonus (rounded down) to ability checks that don't use a proficiency you have.

features.name: Font of Inspiration
features.desc: You also regain Bardic Inspiration when you finish a Short Rest; you can expend a spell slot to regain a use.

features.name: Countercharm
features.desc: As an action, for 1 minute, you and allies within 30 feet have Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened and Charmed conditions.

features.name: Expertise
features.desc: You double your Proficiency Bonus for two more chosen skills.

features.name: Magical Secrets
features.desc: When you prepare spells, you can also choose them from the Druid, Cleric, and Wizard spell lists; they count as Bard spells for you.

features.name: Superior Inspiration
features.desc: If you have no Bardic Inspiration dice left when you roll Initiative, you gain one.

features.name: Words of Creation
features.desc: You always have Power Word Heal and Power Word Kill prepared; a single-target casting can extend its effect to a second creature nearby.
